Étiquetage des Ressources Cloud

The process of assigning metadata labels to cloud resources to facilitate access management, cost allocation, compliance auditing, and automated policy enforcement.

Questions and answers

What is Étiquetage des Ressources Cloud?

In this glossary, Étiquetage des Ressources Cloud refers to: The process of assigning metadata labels to cloud resources to facilitate access management, cost allocation, compliance auditing, and automated policy enforcement.

How is Étiquetage des Ressources Cloud used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Établissez une norme d’étiquetage des ressources cloud pour améliorer les rapports de coûts, le contrôle d’accès et la conformité réglementaire pour tous les déploiements cloud."
